title: Storm Sorceress Over Shipwreck
description: A blue-haired female sorceress in ornate white and turquoise armor floats above a stormy ship graveyard, wielding a glowing spiral staff in one hand while conjuring a swirling vortex of turquoise magic with the other. Ethereal white silhouettes of running figures trail through the magical energy as turbulent waves, rain, and debris swirl around broken wooden ships under a dramatic swirling sky with a bright vortex of light.
